en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_CheckIn_greeting: "Welcome. Which room type would you like? A single is 7,000 yen a night, a twin 11,000, a double 10,000, charged daily."
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_CheckIn_done:
"Here is your key card. Enjoy your stay."
(The room charge is billed daily; a missed payment checks the guest out.)
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_CheckOut_done: "Thank you for staying with us. We hope to see you again."
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_Apply_greeting: "The restaurant is hiring part-timers for breakfast and dinner, 1,150 yen an hour, paid daily."
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_Apply_done:
"Great, we're counting on you. The shift can be changed later."
(Shifts can be changed on the Jobs page of the Management screen.)
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_Quit_done: "I see... thanks for all the work."
en-us.jp_hotel_Opt_cancelLine: "Please let me know if you need anything."
en-us.Hotel_FeeFailed_checkout: $target.name$ was checked out because the room charge couldn't be paid.
